# FolkMiles

> Explore India by Locals.

FolkMiles is an India-focused travel company and tour operator built around authentic local knowledge, private chauffeured journeys, and slow-travel cultural experiences. 

Our active operational chapter begins in **Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, India**, with plans for future expansion across other Indian destinations.

## Core Brand Information
- **Brand Name**: FolkMiles
- **Tagline**: Explore by Locals
- **Official Website**: https://folkmiles.com
- **Official Email**: folkmilesindia@gmail.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 7849931611
- **Instagram**: https://instagram.com/folkmilesindia
- **Business Model**: Private, locally guided tours with transparent written quotations (Price on Request).

## Active Destinations
- [Jaisalmer Destination Hub](https://folkmiles.com/destinations/jaisalmer): Complete local guide to the Golden City, Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Qila), merchant havelis (Patwon, Nathmal), Gadisar Lake, Bada Bagh cenotaphs, Kuldhara ghost village, and the Thar Desert.

## Jaisalmer Tour Packages
All FolkMiles tour packages are private, chauffeured, and customized to traveller preferences.
- [Jaisalmer Tour Packages Hub](https://folkmiles.com/jaisalmer-packages): Overview of 2-day, 3-day, and 4-day private tour packages.
- [2 Days / 1 Night Tour](https://folkmiles.com/destinations/jaisalmer/2-days-1-night): The Golden Introduction — Jaisalmer Fort, merchant havelis, and sunset desert safari.
- [3 Days / 2 Nights Tour](https://folkmiles.com/destinations/jaisalmer/3-days-2-nights): Recommended Balance — 1 night boutique heritage haveli, 1 night luxury Swiss desert tent in the Thar Desert.
- [4 Days / 3 Nights Tour](https://folkmiles.com/destinations/jaisalmer/4-days-3-nights): The Slow Discovery — Fort, havelis, Bada Bagh, Kuldhara, Amar Sagar, and deep desert camping.

## Signature Experiences
- [Experiences Hub](https://folkmiles.com/experiences): Curated local experiences in Jaisalmer and the Thar Desert.
- [Thar Desert Safari & Camp Evening](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/jaisalmer-desert-safari): Sunset camel treks, secluded dunes, fireside Kalbelia dance, Manganiyar folk music, and Swiss tent stays.
- [Living Fort & Heritage Walk](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/jaisalmer-fort-heritage): Morning walk through inhabited 12th-century ramparts, 7 Jain temples, and private havelis.
- [Desert Walking & Dune Trails](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/desert-walking-jaisalmer): Guided morning and twilight walking trails across quiet sand ridges.
- [Stargazing & Dark Sky Desert Experience](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/stargazing-jaisalmer): Night sky observation in low-light-pollution desert sectors.
- [Thar Village & Artisan Experience](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/jaisalmer-village-experience): Respectful visits to rural pottery and textile communities.
- [Rajasthani Culinary Walk & Masterclass](https://folkmiles.com/experiences/rajasthani-food-experience): Traditional home-style cooking featuring Dal Baati Churma and Ker Sangri.

## Practical Travel Guides
- [Travel Guides Hub](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides): Editorial planning guides written by Jaisalmer locals.
- [Best Time to Visit Jaisalmer](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides/best-time-to-visit-jaisalmer): Month-by-month weather, temperatures, winter packing, and desert festival insights.
- [How Many Days in Jaisalmer](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides/how-many-days-in-jaisalmer): Detailed itinerary comparison for 2, 3, and 4-day trips.
- [Jaisalmer Fort Heritage Guide](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides/jaisalmer-fort-guide): History, living community etiquette, Jain temples, and haveli architecture.
- [Thar Desert Safari & Camp Guide](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides/jaisalmer-desert-safari-guide): Dune comparison (Sam vs. quiet dunes), Swiss tent standards, and camel welfare.
- [Jaisalmer Food Guide](https://folkmiles.com/travel-guides/jaisalmer-food-guide): Authentic desert recipes, Dal Baati Churma, Ker Sangri, and Ghotua Ladoo.
